messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: service="inference-gateway" region="us-west-1" severity=high — automated multi-region traffic-shift started but stalled with oscillating weights (us-east-2 <-> us-west-1). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/traffic-shift-mitigation
Sam (oncall): Ack. I'm on-call. Noted: shift started for planned AZ maintenance in us-west-1c at 07:22 UTC. Paging Lila and Jin.
Support Bot: 18 customer error reports in last 4m. Affected: batch-embeds, web-sdk. Error types: increased 5xx and interrupted streaming.
Lila (SRE): Quick summary from health probes: when drain begins, some long-lived streaming connections in us-west-1 linger and proxies mark endpoints healthy due to sticky session reports, so router sees them as usable. When traffic shifts, half of sessions time out and our healthchecks flap between OK/timeout -> controller nudges weight back and forth. We're observing oscillation ~30% ↔ 70% for the last 6 minutes.
Tomas (Platform): Checking orchestrator events — terminationGracePeriod set to 600s for streaming pods. That long drain lets proxies still report node healthy while connection pool is saturated. We should have used a two-phase drain.
Sam (oncall): Proposed mitigations: 1) Pause automated shift controller. 2) Force quick-terminate streams in us-west-1c to expedite failover. 3) Apply sticky-exclusion for critical customers for 10m. Agree?
ops-shift: Holding all infra rollouts. Approve pause.
Jin (NetOps): If we force-terminate at proxy level, upstream clients will reconnect — hopefully to healthy region. I can push a temporary proxy rule to return HTTP/503 for new connections to the draining POPs so they don't accept new streams and force clients to reprovision elsewhere.
Lila (SRE): Implementing pause + proxy rule now. Also starting a background task to collect streaming session list and durations for RCA. Command snippets: ```
# pause controller
curl -XPOST https://admin-router.internal/traffic-controller/pause -d '{"reason":"oncall-mitigation"}'
# set proxy soft-fail
ssh proxy-usw1c 'sudo /usr/local/bin/proxyctl set-new-conn-policy drop'
```
perf-bot: Noted latency spike: p50->p95 jump in us-west-1 at 07:23:40 UTC correlated with shift attempts.
Tomas (Platform): Reducing terminationGracePeriod to 30s on a temporary override for streaming node pool to kill lingering sessions faster. Applying k8s patch: ```
kubectl patch nodepool streaming-usw1 -p '{"spec":{"terminationGracePeriodSeconds":30}}'
```
Sam (oncall): Jin, once proxy rule in place, can you confirm external healthcheck view?
Jin (NetOps): Proxy rule applied to 6 edge proxies in us-west-1c. External LB healthchecks now see 503 for new connections; existing connections are being drained. Router logs show traffic weight adjusting to us-east-2.
Lila (SRE): Router logs: ```
3509876543.1 route-eval: requested=100->applied=85 reason=nosticky_endpoints
3509876550.2 route-eval: post-policy apply -> applied=100 converging
```
Support Bot: Customer reports down to 4 in the last 5m. No session data loss reported, but some users had to reconnect. Top affected: web-sdk long-poll.
Sam (oncall): Timeline note: alert 07:22 UTC, mitigation steps started 07:24 UTC, proxy soft-fail and nodepool override applied 07:26 UTC, traffic converged by 07:30 UTC.
Tomas (Platform): I'm scheduling a platform change: default terminationGracePeriod for streaming workloads will be reduced and we'll introduce a pre-drain hook that signals proxy to refuse new streams before pod termination.
Lila (SRE): Collecting logs and session metadata for RCA. Uploading to /incidents/3509876543/session-logs.tar.gz. Attaching quick RCA notes: sticky session detection gap + long pod grace period caused controller to undercount unhealthy endpoints; controller needs hysteresis when weight changes.
Jin (NetOps): Recommendation: add proxy-level health marker that marks node unhealthy immediately when drain begins, so routing doesn't see stale healthy endpoints. Also add a circuit-breaker to avoid oscillation from repeated shift attempts.
Sam (oncall): Action items for post-incident: 1) implement pre-drain proxy refusal hook (Tomas). 2) add controller hysteresis and min-stable-window to weight applies (Lila). 3) improve customer messaging for streaming session reconnect behavior (Support). 4) run a DR tabletop for traffic-shift scenarios (ops-shift).
ops-shift: I'll own the tabletop and coordinate comms.
Support Bot: Final customer error reports: 0 in last 3m. Monitoring for 30m before declaring mitigated.
Sam (oncall): Handoff: Lila will stay for monitoring until 09:00 UTC, ops-shift taking long tail. Creating incident ticket PD-3509876543 and starting postmortem doc. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
